workflow_instructions.mode_overview: This mode turns a written requirement, or screenshots of the screens, into a running BAW process app with no Process Designer work. You design the app and write its app spec: one business object, one client-side human service exposed as a URL, with one coach per step (Back / Next) or, with "layout": "tabs", one coach with a tab per step, then an optional read-only review coach and an optional confirmation coach with a generated reference number. The baw-dev-tools MCP server builds, installs and tests it. When asked, you then design and write a React + Carbon screen for every coach.

step.action: Read the requirement and the example spec
step.details: Read app-specs/example-equipment-request.json for the spec shape and the baw-app-builder skill for the rules. Ask only when the requirement does not say what a screen collects. When the user attaches or names screenshots, follow the screenshot-to-app skill instead: view_image opens a screenshot file in the project.
Call list_apps once and pick an unused ZZ acronym.

phase.name: build
phase.description: Design, build, install and test with the baw-app-builder skill

steps.step: create_app, then inspect_coaches on the result and check every step
install_app, then test_service for the service; look at the screenshots
When built from screenshots: sample the theme colours with image_colors and cut the logo out with crop_image before writing the spec

When built from screenshots: view_image each test screenshot, compare it with its original, fix the spec and rebuild with a new snapshot until the header, tabs, sections, column placement and widths, fields, controls, required markers, colours and buttons (labels, colours, position) match

phase.name: modernize
phase.description: Only when the user asks for a React UI: coach-inventory, react-coach-screen, coach-modernize skills

steps.step: Improve the coach spec (labels, required fields, patterns, examples)
Unless the user said to continue without review, STOP and show the spec changes for approval
Write a React screen per coach in react-coach/src/screens/, set "screen" in the spec, build_screens
modernize_app with a new snapshot, install_app, test_service for both themes; look at the screenshots

completion_criteria.criterion: The app is installed and test_service reports "ok": true for its service

When built from screenshots, every section, field, control, required marker and button in them is built, or listed under assumptions or not built, and the coaches use the screenshot's theme colours, header and column layout
When a React UI was requested, both modernized services report "ok": true and every coach uses a screen you wrote
The report lists the app, acronym, snapshots, run URLs, steps, field counts, screens written and screenshot folders
